DayBuoy

Terms of use

Effective October 12, 2026. DayBuoy is operated by Jacob Carroll.

The beach, illustrated

DayBuoy visualizes forecasts, not live camera footage. Wave shape, sandbars, breaking positions, cloud shapes and other derived appearance are estimates, labeled with their sources. Forecasts can be delayed, incomplete or inaccurate. Weather data is not intended as the basis for decisions involving serious injury or significant loss. The app describes conditions; it does not provide activity guidance.

Free and DayBuoy+

Live-now viewing and today’s scene scrub are free. DayBuoy+ adds the full-week animated scene, Home Screen widget, optional morning forecast notifications and watermark-free clips. The underlying general-weather readings remain accessible without a subscription through Forecast data.

US prices are $2.99 per month or $19.99 per year. The App Store displays the actual localized price before purchase. A seven-day introductory free trial is available only to eligible customers, once per subscription group. After the trial, payment is charged to your Apple Account at the selected subscription price. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple Account subscription settings. Restore purchases from the DayBuoy+ screen. Apple handles payment and refund requests.

Availability and notifications

Sources, network access and device capabilities affect availability. A missing feed remains unavailable or explicitly last-known. Morning notifications contain downloaded forecasts for the stated hour, with an update timestamp; they are refreshed when the app opens. iOS controls notification and widget delivery timing. Rendering and clip capture vary by device.
